x: Mike Broadbent finished second to Grieve in the 100 yards. John Cope was second to Pugh in the 440 and we had first two home in the 880 in Len Marchant and Jack Brown.
In the 100 yards we had Gordon Lowers and Basil Walden, and they both ran well to finish 2nd and 3rd in a race won in 10 seconds dead by Grieve of S.L.H.
A triangular match was held at Tooting on August 2nd between S.L.H., Surrey A.C. and ourselves. Gordon Lowers once again won the 100, beating such men as Grieve, of S.L.H., and D.

However, he won his heat O.K., and in the final was placed 3rd to Grieve of S.L.H. and Lewis of Walton. The 880 yards saw Bob Taylor continue his good form by winning the race in 1 min. 57.3 secs. which equalled last year's time.
